source.name: Duducare demo conversation guide
source.geographic_scope: General guidance only; local recommendations require matching area records
source.limitations: Editable scripted examples, not an AI agronomist, live weather service, or expert consultation.

topics.reply: I cannot select a chemical or provide application rates from a chat message. Ask a qualified extension officer to assess the crop, and follow the locally applicable product label. You can use Crop health to organise a photo and observations for review.

Duducare has dated, simulated weather scenarios only. They do not describe today's field conditions or predict the next rains. Check a current local forecast and speak with your extension officer before making a weather-dependent decision. Planting advice shows the period and limitations of any scenario it uses.

A symptom can have several causes, so I cannot diagnose it here. In Crop health, choose the crop and describe the affected part, when symptoms started, and how they are spreading. Add a clear photo of an affected plant and an overview of the plot if available. The result will show possible matches and evidence gaps.

Use Planting advice to compare the editable local demo records for your selected area and season. Choose a preferred crop if you have one, then review the planting window, practical steps, dated sources, and evidence gaps. Confirm the guidance locally before using it in the field.

Keep a simple record of the crop, what you observed, and the date. My farm lets you save these notes on this browser. They are your observations, not verified advice, and are not shared with other farmers or synced to another device.
